runtime_evidence: artifacts/p3/acceptance-summary.json generated by CI on exact checked-out head; no skipped gate is treated as passed
local_limitation: This coding host lacks Docker/PostgreSQL/Chromium. Runtime acceptance is executed on hosted CI, not represented by local diagnostics.
latency_scope: 20 real loopback API + PostgreSQL attempts, p95 <=700ms; not production load acceptance

gates.gate: P3-DB-001 clean migration/replay and exact phase table boundary
P3-FIX-001 EN/CS executable fixtures load idempotently and publish complete immutable closure
P3-ISO-001 DB owner/profile/language/publication lineage rejects EN/CS and IDOR mismatches
P3-RUN-001 start/resume returns one exact pinned manifest and run pin is immutable
P3-ATT-001 authoritative incorrect/retry/correct records immutable exact-version evidence
P3-ATT-002 same attempt semantic replay is one effect; changed payload and client score tampering reject
P3-REM-001 reveal is assisted zero-weight evidence; remediation has explicit exit and no fabricated success
P3-POLICY-001 retry cap requires explicit reveal; later correction remains assisted
P3-TXN-001 injected failure rolls back attempt/evidence/run/outbox atomically
P3-E2E-001 English and Czech traverse same repository/evaluator; concurrent retry creates one effect set
P3-OUT-001 durable outbox has bounded retry/idempotent settlement and sink failure leaves attempt committed
P3-API-001 auth/CSRF/strict-body/problem details and resume surface are enforced
P3-DB-002 clean database recreation repeats all migrations and synthetic seed

latency.scope: loopback API + real PostgreSQL deterministic attempts; not production load

exact_head_rule: Final closure commit must re-execute the entire acceptance sequence; GitHub logs and artifacts bind the actual checked-out full SHA.
